name: NETSTARS Co.,Ltd.
summary: NETSTARS Co., Ltd. works in the QR code payment industry in Japan. Its StarPay is a multi-cashless payment platform for integrated management of payment services, StarPay-mini is a development platform for mini-applications, and StarPay Order supports cashless, register-free ordering. It also offers regional loyalty point programs, inbound promotion and payment gateway services for financial institutions abroad. Dating from 2009, it has its headquarters in Chuo, Japan.
